simple.title: Design
simple.description: Fixed-scope creative project with a single concept and limited revision rounds.
simple.proposalDescription:
One defended visual concept (not 3 options), up to 2 rounds of revisions per piece, and final source and exported files (PNG, SVG, PDF).
Not included: copywriting, licensed fonts or images, and website implementation.
simple.notes:
Concept presentation: 7 business days after approval and full brief, by {{date}}.
Revisions: 3 business days per round, within the 2 included rounds.
simple.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: 40% on approval and 60% on delivery of the final files.
Extra revision round: R$ 200.00 each, beyond the 2 included.

phased.title: Consulting
phased.description: Phased project: paid diagnosis, action plan and follow-up.
phased.proposalDescription:
Consulting in 3 phases: initial diagnosis with interviews and review of current data, a prioritized action plan with up to 10 recommendations (effort and impact), and 2 follow-up meetings of 60 minutes.
Not included: execution of the recommendations and paid third-party tools.
phased.notes:
Phase 1 — Diagnosis: 5 business days after approval.
Phase 2 — Action plan: 5 business days after phase 1.
Phase 3 — Follow-up: up to 30 days after delivery, ending around {{date}}.
phased.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: 50% on approval (deposit) and 50% on delivery of the action plan.
To approve, confirm acceptance in writing or sign through the link sent.

recurring.title: Marketing
recurring.description: Monthly retainer with a fixed monthly scope and clear cancellation rules.
recurring.proposalDescription:
Monthly scope: planning and content calendar, 12 posts (design + caption), paid campaign management, and a monthly report with results and next steps.
Not included: media budget, on-location video production and PR.
recurring.notes:
Expected start: by {{date}}, in the next cycle after approval.
Monthly scope is fixed; extra requests are quoted separately. Media budget is paid by the client.
recurring.terms:
This proposal is valid until {{date}}.
Payment: monthly fee on the 5th, with automatic renewal and annual inflation adjustment.
Cancellation with 30 days notice, no penalty.
